text:
ana: Quick sync — ACME asked for a special surge bucket exemption for their pilot. They want a per-route burst above committed slabs for 3 months, no extra commit. Need to decide guardrails by EOD Friday.

elaine: TL;DR from ACME: proof-of-concept will spike unpredictable for short windows. They won't sign higher commit; they asked if we can allow 2 ephemeral bursts/month up to 48h each.

sam: Do we have telemetry to estimate real impact? last month across similar pilots we saw 4x baseline during bursts but short duration. I can pull sample histograms.

jules: Engineering constraints: ephemeral bursts mean autoscale + cold start buffers. If we allow 48h uncontrolled, risk knocking other tenants unless we enforce per-route caps or throttles. Prefer: capped qps + soft-priority tagging.

prateek: From finance: we can't offer unlimited free bursts — need a pricing floor or credit usage. Proposal: 2 free bursts/month up to 10k qps or X tokens, then charged at on-demand rate.

ana: @ana (typo) — (ignore)

ana: sorry, meant to ping @ana :)

ana: (remove this; accidental)

ana: (deleted)

ana: <-- ignore these dummy messages

elaine: ACME legal asked for a clause: "Customer bursts shall not constitute a permanent usage increase for pricing recalibration during the initial pilot term" — they want explicit carveout.

ana: (again accidental noise)

ana: removed again

ana: Back on track: Suggested launch criteria for us: 1) engineering doc with failure isolation pattern, 2) telemetry gating + alerting for cross-tenant impact, 3) finance-approved billing text, 4) legal-approved pilot clause.

jules: Implementation sketch: add `surge_bucket` object to route config with fields: `max_duration_hours`, `max_qps`, `monthly_occurrences`, `priority`. Example:```json
{
  "surge_bucket": {"max_duration_hours":48, "max_qps":10000, "monthly_occurrences":2, "priority":"soft"}
}
```
This allows runtime enforcement + metrics.

sam: I can produce 7-day and 90-day sim of impact if we apply those caps. Will post numbers by tomorrow morning.

prateek: Pricing text for negotiations: "Two complimentary surge events per billing month up to 10k QPS or 500M tokens, thereafter billed at on-demand per-token rates. Redwood reserves right to throttle to preserve system health." That gives us a safety valve.

elaine: ACME will push back on the throttle sentence. Legal can soften language to "reasonable protective measures" — but we need explicit throttle triggers.

jules: Agree. We need deterministic triggers: CPU% > 85% on serving cluster or tail latency > 500ms for >5min -> start throttling lowest-priority burst routes. Put this in runbook.

ana: Quick question: do we expose burst usage in Console (per-route spike chart) so customers can see remaining occurrences? Important for ACME.

sam: Yes — that's an easy UI hook once telemetry emits `surge_bucket.used` events. I'll add events.

prateek: Contractually, finance wants a one-off pilot addendum template for sales so we don't bake custom SLA exceptions into core TOS. Elaine can we use the standard pilot addendum with the clause above?

elaine: Yep — will send draft. ACME legal expects a week turnaround.

ana: Next actions: 1) Jules to write engineering spec PR for `surge_bucket` by Thu EOD. 2) Sam to run sim and post impact numbers by Fri AM. 3) Prateek to finalize billing language and floor by Thu. 4) Elaine to draft pilot addendum and negotiate with ACME. 5) Ana to own rollout decision after artifacts.

jules: Noted. I'll include fallback policy: automatic model variant downgrade to smaller quantized model if burst causes sustained tail issues.

sam: Putting a placeholder ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7123 (created)

bizbot: INF-7123 assigned to jules, sam, prateek — due 2026-05-07.

elaine: If we get approve from legal/finance this week and engineering spec looks solid, we can sign ACME pilot next Tue.

prateek: One more: add a telemetry SLA for pilot (we must guarantee 24h accurate reporting on surge usage or we can't bill/credit reliably).

ana: Good call. I'll add that to acceptance criteria.

jules: Will include telemetry contract in spec.

ana: Thanks all — I'll collate and send a short decision doc to execs after Fri AM numbers.
